fields.inode_bitmap_start: Starting block of inode allocation bitmap
fields.block_bitmap_start: Starting block of data block bitmap
fields.data_blocks_start: Starting block of data blocks pool

ipo_inode.title: IPO_FS Inode Structure (128 bytes, 4 per block)

fields.extents: 4 primary contiguous extent descriptors (24 B each)
fields.next_extent_node: Physical block of chained extent node (0 if none)

fields.physical_block: Starting physical LBA block in storage pool

storage_pool_raw_sb.title: Storage Pool Superblock (storage_pool_raw_sb_t, LBA 2030 & 2039)
storage_pool_raw_sb.totalSize: 512 bytes (68 B header + flexible members[] + CRC32)

fields.local_member_uuid: 128-bit UUID of the local drive member
fields.member_index: Index of this drive in the spanned pool
fields.member_count: Total number of drives in the storage pool
fields.total_capacity_sectors: Combined capacity across all member drives in sectors
fields.members: Flexible on-disk array of member descriptors (48 B each)

storage_raw_disk_tx_entry.title: Storage Pool WAL Journal Entry (storage_raw_disk_tx_entry_t, LBA 2031–2038)
storage_raw_disk_tx_entry.totalSize: 64 bytes (8 entries per 512-byte sector, 64 entries total)

fields.lba: Target logical block address in storage pool
fields.count: Number of sectors affected by transaction
fields.data_crc: CRC32 checksum of the written sector payload
fields.entry_crc: CRC32 checksum of the journal entry header

kmod_header.title: Relocatable Kernel Module Header (kmod_raw_header_t / kmod_header_t)
kmod_header.totalSize: 192 bytes (0xC0 on-disk raw) / Dynamic pointers in RAM

fields.name: Module identifier (dynamic char* in kmod_header_t)
fields.author: Module author string (dynamic char* in kmod_header_t)
fields.version: Semantic version string (dynamic char* in kmod_header_t)
fields.init_offset: Byte offset of init() entrypoint from .text start
fields.cleanup_offset: Byte offset of cleanup() from .text start
fields.text/data/bss_size: Sizes of .text, .data, and .bss sections in bytes
fields.sym_tab_offset/count: Offset and count of external symbol table entries
fields.reloc_offset/count: Offset and count of ABS32/REL32 relocation records
fields.checksum: CRC32 checksum of the module payload

fields.cpu_id: Logical processor core ID (0 = BSP, 1..N = AP)
fields.is_online: Set to true once AP finishes trampoline boot
fields.stack_base: Allocated 16 KB per-CPU kernel stack base
fields.stack_top: Initial ESP top of stack passed to AP trampoline

fields.pid: Unique process ID (allocated dynamically starting from 1)
fields.binary_base: Base address of loaded executable image in allocated memory block (mem)
fields.binary_size: 4 KB page-aligned binary memory size in bytes
fields.entry_point: Absolute execution entry point (allocated free block mem address)
fields.binary_storage: Reserved backup buffer pointer (NULL in in-place execution)
fields.data_offset: Offset where writable data/bss begins in image
fields.data_size: Size of writable data/bss segment in bytes
fields.code_mapped: True if code segment has been loaded into memory
fields.stack_ptr: Saved ESP stack pointer during multitasking
fields.stack_size: Stack capacity in bytes (256 KB initial)
fields.argv_addr: Address of argv pointers array in process space
fields.argv_kernel: Copy of argv array in kernel space for debugging
fields.return_val: Full typed return value (type, int, raw_eax/edx, dynamic strings, struct buffer)
fields.return_val_explicit: True if process explicitly set custom return value via syscall
fields.waiting_for_input: Blocked waiting for keyboard / terminal input
fields.gfx_overlay_flags: VGA Mode 13h overlay visibility flags (VGA_OVERLAY_HIDE_BUTTON, VGA_OVERLAY_HIDE_CURSOR)
fields.is_wm_app: Created a Window Manager desktop window
fields.async_task_count: Count of active background async tasks
fields.user_heap_limit: Per-process isolated heap ceiling limit address
fields.user_heap_slot: Dynamic memory slot index assigned to process (-1 if none)
fields.exec_inode: Executable inode metadata for on-demand progressive loading
fields.demand_loading: True if executable is currently being loaded on-demand
fields.demand_file_offset: Current byte offset in executable binary file on disk
fields.demand_mem_offset: Current destination offset in process memory image
fields.demand_loaded_bytes: Total bytes of executable loaded into memory so far
fields.demand_total_bytes: Total byte size of all loadable binary segments
fields.text_vram_backup: 80x25 text mode buffer backup for workspace switching
fields.gfx_vram_backup: 320x200 graphics VRAM backup when swapped to background
fields.text_cursor_pos: Saved cursor coordinate in text mode
fields.completed_and_acknowledged: Process completed and acknowledged by parent
fields.scroll_top_count: Count of lines in top scrollback buffer
fields.scroll_bottom_count: Count of lines in bottom scrollback buffer
fields.window_id: Workspace window group identifier in batch mode
fields.text_screen_shared: True if VRAM buffers are shared with co-process
fields.text_output_len: Length of captured stdout text in bytes
fields.name: Dynamically allocated process name string
fields.return_format: Auto-detected format descriptor from DWARF debug symbols
fields.next: Pointer to next PCB in active kernel list

device_node.title: Unified Hardware Device Node (device_node_t)
device_node.totalSize: 148 bytes (0x94) with dynamic strings & self-expanding BAR array (src/include/kernel/device.h)

fields.parent_id: Parent bus/controller device ID (0 if root)
fields.capabilities: Capability bitmask (READONLY, REMOVABLE, HOTPLUGGABLE, DMA, VIRTUAL)
fields.type: Category (CPU, MEMORY, PCI, STORAGE, NETWORK, INPUT, AUDIO, VIDEO, SYSTEM, USB)
fields.state: Operational state (DISCOVERED, DRIVER_ATTACHED, INITIALIZED, ACTIVE, DISABLED, ERROR)
fields.name: Dynamic canonical identifier (e.g. "cpu0", "pci00:03.0", "ata0")
fields.vendor / model / description: Dynamically allocated vendor, model, and functional description strings
fields.res: Bus coordinates, PCI IDs, dynamic uint32_t* bar[], I/O base, MMIO base, IRQ, size_bytes
fields.driver_name / driver_ptr: Attached driver name and pointer to driver_t
fields.ops / priv_data / next: Standard VFS-like device I/O operations (open/close/read/write/ioctl) and list link

fields.heap_total: Total kernel heap capacity in bytes (64 MB / 0x04000000)
fields.heap_used: Bytes consumed by high-watermark with headers
fields.free_bytes: Bytes available in free blocks pool

fields.irq: Hardware IRQ line (14 for Primary, 15 for Secondary)
fields.model: Dynamically allocated NUL-terminated ATA model string
fields.serial: Dynamically allocated NUL-terminated ATA serial string
fields.firmware: Dynamically allocated NUL-terminated ATA firmware revision string

fields.base_lo: Lower 16 bits of ISR entrypoint address
fields.base_hi: Upper 16 bits of ISR entrypoint address

fields.POST_MRC_START: Memory Reference Code DRAM training started
fields.POST_CAR_TEARDOWN: CAR teardown complete, stack relocated to DRAM
fields.ERR_NO_MTRR: CPU lacks MTRR support or CAR setup failed

fields.FW_A20_ACTIVE: Fast A20 Gate activated and verified
fields.FW_STORAGE_PROBE: Storage controllers probing (ATA, AHCI, NVMe, USB)
fields.FW_ERR_NO_BOOT: No bootable media found on any controller
